name: Brick Map
definition: A two-level sparse spatial data structure for ray tracing that combines a low-resolution full voxel grid with high-resolution sparse 'bricks' to store triangle indices, avoiding the traversal complexity of BVHs and SVOs while skipping free space.
summary: A Brick Map is a two-level sparse voxel grid for real-time ray tracing that uses a low-resolution grid and high-resolution sparse bricks to enable branch-free traversal and avoid BVH complexity.
